questions.text: Approximately how much weight have you lost, and over what time period did this occur?
questions.purpose: Quantify the weight loss to distinguish clinically significant loss (>5% in 3 months or >10% in 6 months)
options: More than 10% of body weight over 6 months

questions.text: Has your appetite decreased significantly, or are you eating the same amount as before the weight loss?
questions.purpose: Distinguish anorexia-driven loss (more sinister) from weight loss despite normal intake (cachexia)

questions.text: Do you have any new lumps, swellings, or enlarged lymph nodes anywhere on your body?
questions.purpose: Identify possible tumour mass or lymphadenopathy pointing to malignancy

questions.text: Have you had persistent night sweats or unexplained fevers during this period?
questions.purpose: Identify B-symptoms of lymphoma or other haematological malignancy

questions.text: Have you noticed any change in your bowel habits, rectal bleeding, or difficulty swallowing?
questions.purpose: Screen for GI malignancy as cause of weight loss

questions.text: Have you had any persistent cough, coughing up blood, or new breathing difficulties?
questions.purpose: Screen for lung malignancy contributing to constitutional weight loss

questions.text: Are you experiencing any fatigue, pallor, or easy bruising that is new or worsening?
questions.purpose: Identify features suggesting bone marrow involvement or haematological malignancy
